comparisons.label: Initial Term Loan Applicable Rate multi-era grid (same definition amended across Am1/Am3/Am4)
comparisons.beforeText: Per Fourth Amendment historical recount: prior to First Amendment Effective Date — SOFR 4.25% / Base 3.25%; after First but before Third — SOFR 3.75% / Base 2.75%; after Third but before Fourth — SOFR 3.25% / Base 2.25%.
comparisons.afterText: (ii) with respect to any Initial Term Loan, (A) at any time prior to the First Amendment Effective Date, (x) for any Adjusted Term SOFR Loan, 4.25% per annum and (y) for any Base Rate Loan, 3.25% per annum, (B) at any time on or following the First Amendment Effective Date but prior to the Third Amendment Effective Date, (x) for any Adjusted Term SOFR Loan, 3.75% per annum and (y) for any Base Rate Loan, 2.75% per annum, (C) at any time on or following the Third Amendment Effective Date but prior to the Fourth Amendment Effective Date, (x) for any Adjusted Term SOFR Loan, 3.25% per annum, and (y) for any Base Rate Loan, 2.25% per annum and (D) at any time on or following the Fourth Amendment Effective Date, (x) for any Adjusted Term SOFR Loan, 2.50% per annum, and (y) for any Base Rate Loan, 1.50% per annum,

authority.quote: Clause (a)(ii) of the definition of "Applicable Rate" is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: (ii) with respect to any Initial Term Loan, (A) at any time prior to the First Amendment Effective Date, (x) for any Adjusted Term SOFR Loan, 4.25% per annum and (y) for any Base Rate Loan, 3.25% per annum, (B) at any time on or following the First Amendment Effective Date but prior to the Third Amendment Effective Date, (x) for any Adjusted Term SOFR Loan, 3.75% per annum and (y) for any Base Rate Loan, 2.75% per annum, (C) at any time on or following the Third Amendment Effective Date but prior to the Fourth Amendment Effective Date, (x) for any Adjusted Term SOFR Loan, 3.25% per annum, and (y) for any Base Rate Loan, 2.25% per annum and (D) at any time on or following the Fourth Amendment Effective Date, (x) for any Adjusted Term SOFR Loan, 2.50% per annum, and (y) for any Base Rate Loan, 1.50% per annum,

notes: Operative defined term is Applicable Rate (Am4 §1(b)). Recital colloquial 'Applicable Margin' is non-controlling.
This is a single definition carrying amendment-chain pricing history — query-date sensitive.
Second Amendment is in the chain but does not appear as a pricing breakpoint in this Applicable Rate clause (other Am2 changes not asserted without extraction).
Historical eras in the post-Am4 restated definition are not a substitute for contemporaneous Am1/Am3 then-current text for pre-Am4 as-of queries without caveats.
All First/Third/Fourth Amendment Effective Dates remain CONDITIONAL_UNRESOLVED.
